answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the terrace of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cedar holds work receipts rather than names, so the sonnet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
